slides.slide_title: Intro to Autonomy of Cars and GPU Units

key_points: Transitioned from specialized graphics rendering to general-purpose parallel processing.
Optimized architecture for massive parallelism enhances efficiency in data-intensive tasks.
Core strength lies in thousands of smaller cores designed for throughput, unlike CPUs focused on latency.

slides.slide_title: Business Value of GPUs in AI
key_points: Accelerates time-to-discovery in complex computational science, enhancing accessibility.
Provides energy-efficient performance critical for large-scale AI and deep learning applications.
Essential for real-time data processing, driving technological innovation across sectors.
Promises reduced traffic congestion and optimized fuel efficiency through advanced algorithms.
Significantly decreases accident rates by minimizing human error in driving.
Challenges include navigating complex environments and addressing ethical and legal considerations.

slides.slide_title: Sensor Fusion and Perception in AVs
key_points: Foundation of self-driving systems relies on advanced sensors like LiDAR, radar, and cameras.
Accurate environmental perception is critical for safe navigation and decision-making.
Integration of sensor data enhances reliability and performance in varied driving conditions.
Modern GPUs include Tensor Cores optimized for low-precision matrix operations in deep learning.
High core density and high-bandwidth memory support rapid model training and optimization.
Critical for training large neural networks used in autonomous systems and AI applications.

slides.slide_title: The Role of GPUs in High-Performance Computing
key_points: Facilitates General-Purpose computing on Graphics Processing Units (GPGPU) for simulations.
Enables modeling of complex phenomena across various scientific fields, enhancing research capabilities.
Parallel architecture allows for unprecedented scales and resolutions in computational tasks.

slides.slide_title: Conclusion: The Future of Autonomous Vehicles and GPUs
key_points: The synergy between GPUs and autonomous vehicle technology is pivotal for future advancements.
Continued innovation in GPU architecture will support the evolving demands of AI and AVs.
Strategic investment in these technologies is essential for maintaining competitive advantage in the market.
